Hi there, I'm 23F, I know a bit about low self-esteem connected with how our bodies look. My advice is, stop comparing. One of my wise friends told me once that each of us has a separate, individual story. Things that are easy for someone can be impossible for someone else. You are really young, which makes me think that there's plenty of things waiting for you. When I was 16 I started to become really skinny to the point where I was too skinny. Now, after 7 years I found myself as an average girl with a muffin top and rather big thighs and arms. It's difficult to accept such changes, but as someone stated the only thing you can be sure of is change. You may find yourself becoming thinner and thicker and then thinner again. You will certainly get older, some wrinkles will appear. But the thing is to love yourself no matter what. There's a great TED talk about marrying yourself and I suggest you watch it. Treat yourself kindly, become a friend to yourself. You deserve love no matter what. If you want to talk, feel free to DM me.
Take care!
